snippet.title: Wonder Garden - Trailer | A Cozy Garden That Grows on Your Desktop
snippet.description:
🌱 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5441740/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer

Wonder Garden is a cozy idle garden that lives right on your desktop. Draw shelves anywhere on your screen, plant seeds, water them — and watch real-looking 3D plants slowly grow while you work, study or play.

🌿 18 plant species — monstera, hydrangea, bonsai, orchid, Venus flytrap, a mimosa that folds when you touch it, a moon vine that opens its flowers at night, and more
🧬 Every plant is unique: its own shape, colours and rare forms to discover and record in the Almanac
🏺 Hundreds of ways to style your garden: pots, hanging planters, garlands and shelf decor
🐝 A bee house, butterflies raised from caterpillars, and rare visitors like ladybirds, snails and fireflies
🎁 Seasonal surprises: a Christmas tree as a gift every December
🌙 Low on resources — it rests when you're in a full-screen game

Your garden grows slowly, over days — a calm little corner of life on your screen.

Available for Windows and macOS. Languages: English, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean.

💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/H6xfvVyesP
🌐 Website: https://wondergarden.net/

#WonderGarden #CozyGames #DesktopCompanion #IdleGame #Gardening
